Non_Retirees::DW2.formula: IF(OR(AND(F2="XRD",G2="V"),ISBLANK(DR2)),"NULL",IF(DV2="D","Your current monthly benefit of $"&TEXT(DR2,"#,#00.00")&" will decrease to $"&TEXT(DT2,"#,#00.00")&" because an incorrect Adjustment Factor for Late Retirement was applied when calculating your estimated benefit.
